_comment: Anomaly kinds (world/anomalies, docs/ANOMALIES.md). messages = flavour text variants (one picked per site); rewards = [{ore, min, max, weight}] (one entry picked per site, then an amount); detect_mult = x anomalies.detect_range (0.1..5); weight = how often generation picks the kind; optional blueprint = a data/blueprints.json id unlocked on investigation (docs/BLUEPRINTS.md).

derelict_wreckage.name: Derelict Wreckage
messages: A gutted freighter drifts in silence. You strip what is left of its hold.
Twisted hull plates and a cold reactor. Someone never made it home.
An old mining tug, its cargo bay still sealed.

energy_signature.name: Energy Signature
messages: A pulsing knot of energy collapses as you arrive, leaving charged dust behind.
The readings spike, then fall silent. Crystals have formed in the wake.

ancient_artifact.name: Ancient Artifact
messages: A carved monolith older than the star charts. Its core is solid platinum.
Alien glyphs glow faintly on a tumbling obelisk. You pry loose a precious seam.

unstable_phenomenon.name: Unstable Phenomenon
messages: Space folds and snaps back. Fragments of some other place rain against the hull.
A shimmering rift closes behind you, shedding strange metals.

ancient_blueprint_cache.name: Ancient Blueprint Cache
messages: A sealed data vault hums awake at your approach and streams schematics into your ship's computer.
Inside a shattered archive pod, one memory core still holds a complete fabrication pattern.
